```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Load the preprocessed data
data <- read_csv("../data/final_preprocessed_data.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Diagnostic Function
cat("\n--- Investigating Rank Deficiency ---\n")
fit <- lm(Thermostat_Temperature ~ ., data = data %>% select(-DateTime))

# The 'alias' function finds linear dependencies the correlation check missed
alias_info <- alias(fit)

if(!is.null(alias_info$Complete)) {
  cat("\n!!! CRITICAL REDUNDANCIES FOUND !!!\n")
  cat("The following variables are causing 100% deficiency:\n")
  print(rownames(alias_info$Complete))
  
  cat("\nMathematical relationship (Why they are redundant):\n")
  print(alias_info$Complete)
} else {
  cat("\nNo global perfect linear dependencies found.\n")
}
```
